protocol: Frozen r7 update-29 sampled policies, independent fit/test streams; all valid decision rows including reset priors, no warmup exclusion. Separate affine least-squares decoder and encoder per site (SVD rcond 1e-6). Tune the smallest grid λ whose pooled Good→Bad pickup is below intact Bad pickup; if none qualifies, use the grid endpoint and explicitly report selection failure. Freeze across agents/sites. Matched environment/action RNG across conditions. Bad→Good stops after the first target-rock sample; Good→Bad continues every step. K/V propagation is preserved.
